where.description: On the card, or on every row of a list or of pictures.

send.description: How the body goes: as JSON, or as a form (a flat body).

danger.description: Red, and asks twice before it runs.

asks.description: Blanks whoever presses the button fills in.

answer.description: A JMESPath expression in the service's answer whose value is shown instead of Done.
